location_qualifier: Red Beach; 35th RCT landing, first element of the division
composing_text: The first of the division infantry combat teams landed this day; the other two followed in the next three weeks (Miller, chapter IX).
source_locator: R2225: ch. IX; R2227: Part VI, ch. 9
notes: Miller, ch. IX, and Hough, Ludwig and Shaw, Part VI, ch. 9: the 35th Regimental Combat Team landed at Beach Red on 17 December 1942, the first element of the 25th Division. This row is the start of the division’s landing, not a claim that the whole division was ashore on 17 December. Confidence 0.7.

location_qualifier: Galloping Horse; XIV Corps first January offensive
composing_text: The infantry regiment on the division right (north) against the Galloping Horse, as described in Miller, chapters XI–XII.
source_locator: R2225: ch. XI, Capturing of the Galloping Horse
notes: XIV Corps’ first January offensive opened on 10 January 1943; the 25th Division led, with the 27th Infantry on the right against the Galloping Horse (Miller, ch.
